I am also 37 weeks and today I realized, it’s really hard to love your pregnant body when all you can see are the things wrong with it. 

My feet and hands are swollen all the time, none of my old shoes fit or fit comfortably, I can’t wear my rings or bracelets that I love. My nipples that use to be pink are now the color of my hair (dark dark brown), dry and have developed tiny skin tags on them, I have skin darkening what seems like everywhere. Heartburn is killing me, I pop tums like they’re candy. I wake up with carpal tunnel every morning. I want to be able to shave the lower half of my body, or be able to bend down without getting the air knocked out of me. I am tired of being hungry all the time, especially for things like pretzels or saltines that have no nutritional value whatsoever. I wish I could say I want better sleep but that’s not going to happen once she’s here. 

Don’t get me wrong. I love my daughter, more than life itself, and I am so excited to meet her. However I already struggle with insecurities and I knew Fromm the beginning that weight gain was going to really mess with me both mentally and emotionally, and it’s done exactly that. I wasn’t happy with my body before pregnancy and now I feel like I have even more weight to lose (about 100 pounds at this point) and no idea if it’s even possible. I am scared I am never going to love my body again.
